## CITY OF CORAL GABLES, FLORIDA

## RESOLUTION NO. 2024- 38

A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COMMISSION AUTHORIZING AN EMERGENCY PURCHASE FOR THE REPLACEMENT OF TRANE CHILLER NO.  1' S ADAPTIVE FREQUENCY DRIVE ( AFD) POWER MODULE COMPONENT AT THE PUBLIC SAFETY BUILDING ( PSB), 2151 SALZEDO STREET, PURSUANT TO SECTION 2-690 EMERGENCY PROCUREMENT,  OF THE CITY'S PROCUREMENT CODE IN THE AMOUNT OF $141,094.

WHEREAS,  the PSB' s chiller no.  1 has failed due to complications with the adaptive frequency drive (AFD) power module component; and

WHEREAS, currently, chiller no. 2 has been running at 100% to compensate for the failed chiller;  and

WHEREAS,  the Trane company has rebuilt chiller no. 1 under warranty however Trane claims this component is not covered.   Currently, the City Attorney's Office is looking into possible legal options;  and

WHEREAS,  currently,  the City Attorney' s Office is looking into possible legal options; and

WHEREAS,  to avoid disruptions to the building's air conditioning,  it is recommended repairs are made expeditiously;

## NOW,  THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF CORAL GABLES:

SECTION 1.   The foregoing ' WHEREAS'  clauses are hereby ratified and confirmed as being true and correct and are hereby made a specific part of this Resolution upon adoption hereof.

SECTION 2. That the City Commission approve the emergency repairs in the amount of $25,387 for this project,  pursuant to Section 2-690 of the City' s Procurement Code.

SECTION 3. That this Resolution shall become effective upon the date of its passage and adoption herein.

## PASSED AND ADOPTED THIS TWENTY-SEVENTH DAY OF FEBRUARY,

A.D., 2024.

Moved:   Fernandez / Seconded:   Anderson) Unanimous Voice Vote) Agenda Item:  D-2)
